app.name: DemoDay
app.notice: AI scores are decision support, not final results.
evaluate.title: Judge the demo,
evaluate.sub: Upload one team's 3-minute video. DemoDay scores it against the rubric on what the team actually showed.
evaluate.photoAlt: A team presenting their project on a hackathon stage while the next team waits
evaluate.dropzone.title: Drop a video here or
evaluate.dropzone.hint: MP4, MOV or WebM · up to {maxMb} · about 3 minutes, 16:9 screen recording with narration
evaluate.failedHelp: No score was saved. Evaluate the video again.
evaluate.recentEmpty: No evaluations yet. Upload a team video to get its first scorecard.
evaluate.howBody: The AI watches the whole video, including audio, and scores each rubric category from 1 to 5 with remarks. The overall score is the weighted average of the category scores.
evaluate.announceDone: Evaluation completed. Overall AI score {score} out of 5.
evaluate.uploadNetwork: The upload did not reach DemoDay. Check the connection and try again.
clock.over: Over the {limit} limit, will be flagged
result.title: Scorecard
result.notFoundBody: This evaluation is not stored. It may have been deleted. Evaluate the video again to get a new scorecard.
rubric.title: Rubric
rubric.sub: The criteria the AI applies to every team video. Read when each evaluation starts.
rubric.photoAlt: Hackathon participants working on laptops around a table
rubric.defaultBody: No rubric.md was found in the data folder, so the version-controlled default rubric applies.
rubric.activeBody: Read from rubric.md in the data folder.
rubric.invalidBody: {detail}. Evaluations fail until rubric.md is fixed.
rubric.caption: Rubric categories, weights and scoring tiers
rubric.weightNote: Overall score = weighted average of the category scores. Weights total {total}%, so each weight counts relative to that total.
rubric.fileNote: Read-only. Edit rubric.md in the data folder to change it; the next evaluation uses the new version.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.e: Show or hide all remarks on a scorecard
error.ORIGIN_MISMATCH: The request came from another site and was refused
error.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Unsupported file type. Use MP4, MOV or WebM.
error.NOT_A_VIDEO: File is not a readable video
error.VIDEO_UNPROCESSABLE: Video could not be processed (corrupted or unsupported format)
error.PROCESSING_TOO_LONG: Video processing did not finish. Retry later.
error.AI_REJECTED: AI service rejected the request (check configuration)
error.AI_BLOCKED: The AI declined to score this video ({reason})
error.INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT: The AI returned an incomplete scorecard
error.STORE_CORRUPT: Saved data for this item could not be read
error.INTERNAL: Something failed inside DemoDay. Retry, and check the server log if it repeats.
help.VIDEO_UNPROCESSABLE: Check that the file plays on your computer, then evaluate it again.
help.AI_UNAVAILABLE: No score was saved. Evaluate the video again in a few minutes.
help.default: No score was saved. Evaluate the video again.
error.INVALID_FOLDER_URL: Enter a Google Drive folder link
error.FOLDER_NOT_SHARED: DemoDay cannot read this folder. Share it as 'Anyone with the link' and try again.
error.NO_TEAM_FOLDERS: No team folders found in this folder
error.DRIVE_PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission denied or file not shared
error.DRIVE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google Drive is not configured. Set GOOGLE_DRIVE_API_KEY in .env.local and restart.
error.BATCH_ALREADY_RUNNING: Another batch is running. Wait for it to finish, then start this one.
help.DRIVE_PERMISSION_DENIED: Ask the team to share the video as 'Anyone with the link'.
help.NO_VIDEO_IN_FOLDER: Ask the team to add an MP4, MOV or WebM video to their folder.
help.DRIVE_UNAVAILABLE: No score was saved. Start the batch again later to retry this team.
warn.multipleVideos: {count} videos found; used the most recent ({chosen})
batches.title: Judge a whole folder
batches.sub: Paste the link to a Google Drive folder with one subfolder per team. DemoDay judges each team's video in turn.
batches.photoAlt: Hackathon participants at laptops watching a project demo on a projector screen
batches.formHint: Share the folder as 'Anyone with the link'. Each team subfolder should contain one MP4, MOV or WebM video.
batches.listEmpty: No batches yet. Paste a Google Drive folder link to judge every team in it.
batch.interruptedBody: The server stopped while teams were being judged. Completed teams are saved; resume to continue from the next team in the queue.
panel.label: {team} scorecard
panel.notReady: This team has no scorecard yet.
shortcuts.jk: Next or previous team in a batch
error.NOT_RESUMABLE: Nothing to resume: every team has finished
error.NOT_RETRYABLE: Only failed items can be retried
batch.pausedBody: Teams already judged are saved. Resume to continue with the next team in the queue.
error.VIDEO_TOO_LARGE: Video is too large for Vertex AI (limit {limit})
help.VIDEO_TOO_LARGE: Use a shorter or lower-resolution export, or switch AI_PROVIDER to gemini for this video.
evidence.title: Evidence from the video
evidence.legendClaimed: claimed (only said or on a slide)
evidence.none: No evidence details for this result (judged before this feature).
video.label: Team video
video.missing: The video file for this evaluation is no longer stored.
error.OVERRIDE_NOTE_REQUIRED: Add a note explaining the override
error.OVERRIDE_SCORE_INVALID: Score must be a whole number from 1 to 5
error.NO_RESULT: There is no AI score to override yet
override.title: Override {name}
override.label: {name}: final {final} out of 5, AI {ai}
error.JOB_ACTIVE: Pause or wait until it finishes, then delete
delete.bodyEvaluation: This removes the scorecard and the stored video from DemoDay. This cannot be undone.
delete.bodyBatch: This removes the batch and its {count} team results from DemoDay. Files in Google Drive are not changed. This cannot be undone.
